subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should Plugin SDK expose result-level yield now with an enforced sequential-tool contract, or should this public control surface be deferred?
rationale: This is a permanent external Plugin SDK scheduling contract, and runtime code cannot safely infer before batch admission that an unrestricted tool or result-finalization hook will later request a yield.

options.title: Approve constrained yield API
options.body: Keep the helper, but require and enforce static sequential execution before accepting yield controls, with explicit rejection and documentation for unsafe callers.

options.title: Defer the public control
options.body: Leave plugin tools on existing interaction paths until maintainers choose a broader scheduling or structured-interaction API.

recommendation.title: Approve constrained yield API
recommendation.body: Keep the helper, but require and enforce static sequential execution before accepting yield controls, with explicit rejection and documentation for unsafe callers.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the public Plugin SDK and agent-runtime scheduling boundary recently maintained in this area.
